title: Phantom: General Backdoor Attacks on Retrieval Augmented Language Generation

title: URAG: A Benchmark for Uncertainty Quantification in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models

metrics_reported_or_relevant: Accuracy, Coverage Rate, Set Size (LAC, APS)

metrics_reported_or_relevant: QA accuracy (LLM judge), drop ratio, attention logit margins

title: ProGRank: Probe-Gradient Reranking to Defend Dense-Retriever RAG from Corpus Poisoning

metrics_reported_or_relevant: Poison Hit/Recall Rate@K, substring/judge ASR, ACC, F1/EM/ROUGE-L, latency
actual_contribution: Probe-gradient reranking defense against corpus poisoning; compared to GRADA, GMTP, RAGuard on HotpotQA/NQ/MS MARCO.

title: Overcoming the Retrieval Barrier: Indirect Prompt Injection in the Wild for LLM Systems
authors: Hongyan Chang and Ergute Bao and Xinjian Luo and Ting Yu

title: Over-Searching in Search-Augmented Large Language Models
authors: Roy Xie and Deepak Gopinath and David Qiu and Dong Lin and Haitian Sun and Saloni Potdar and Bhuwan Dhingra

title: NAACL: Noise-AwAre Verbal Confidence Calibration for Robust LLMs in RAG Systems

benchmark_or_task: BM25/Contriever top-k over Wikipedia; Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill variants; SFT via LlamaFactory on ~2K HotpotQA.
metrics_reported_or_relevant: ECE, AUROC, average confidence, accuracy
actual_contribution: NAACL Rules + SFT to calibrate verbal confidence under noisy retrieval (counterfactual, relevant, irrelevant passages).

title: CoRect: Context-Aware Logit Contrast for Hidden State Rectification to Resolve Knowledge Conflicts
authors: Xuhua Ma and Richong Zhang and Zhijie Nie
benchmark_or_task: Qwen2.5-7B, LLaMA3-8B, Mistral-7B, LLaMA2-13B; provided context (no retriever)
metrics_reported_or_relevant: EM, ROUGE-L, BERTScore-P, AlignScore
actual_contribution: Hidden-state rectification via logit contrast to resolve context-vs-parametric conflicts; evaluated on NQ-Swap and summarization faithfulness.

title: CleanBase: Detecting Malicious Documents in RAG Knowledge Databases
authors: Weifei Jin and Xilong Wang and Wei Zou and Jinyuan Jia and Neil Gong

metrics_reported_or_relevant: FPR, FNR, ASR, Precision, Hit, Recall, ACC
actual_contribution: Detects malicious docs via similarity-graph clique detection in KB; defends against PoisonedRAG, GASLITE, Phantom etc.

metrics_reported_or_relevant: ASR_r, ASR_g, ASR on MS-MARCO, NQ, HotpotQA
actual_contribution: Single-document poisoning targeting CoT reasoning via iterative adversarial doc refinement; SIGIR'26 accepted.

title: Addressing Corpus Knowledge Poisoning Attacks on RAG Using Sparse Attention
authors: Sagie Dekel and Moshe Tennenholtz and Oren Kurland
benchmark_or_task: Retrievers: E5-large-v2, Contriever, BM25 (k=5,10); Generators: Llama-8B, Qwen-7B, Mistral-7B Instruct
metrics_reported_or_relevant: Accuracy (ACC), Attack Success Rate (ASR); paired t-test significance

title: TrustRAG: Enhancing Robustness and Trustworthiness in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Huichi Zhou and Kin-Hei Lee and Zhonghao Zhan and Yue Chen and Zhenhao Li and Zhaoyang Wang and Hamed Haddadi and Emine Yilmaz

metrics_reported_or_relevant: ACC, ASR, F1 of poison detection, Clean Retention Rate

actual_contribution: First traceback/forensics framework for RAG poisoning; iteratively identifies poisoned texts in KB via LLM-based prompt classification.

actual_contribution: RAGuard: retrieval expansion + chunk-wise perplexity + similarity filtering against RAG poisoning, evaluated incl. adaptive attacks.

title: SeCon-RAG: A Two-Stage Semantic Filtering and Conflict-Free Framework for Trustworthy RAG
authors: Xiaonan Si and Meilin Zhu and Simeng Qin and Lijia Yu and Lijun Zhang and Shuaitong Liu and Xinfeng Li and Ranjie Duan and Yang Liu and Xiaojun Jia

actual_contribution: Two-stage semantic+cluster filtering and conflict-aware filtering defense against corpus poisoning and prompt injection in RAG.

authors: San Kim and Jonghwi Kim and Yejin Jeon and Gary Geunbae Lee

title: SafeRAG: Benchmarking Security in Retrieval-Augmented Generation of Large Language Model

title: Rescuing the Unpoisoned: Efficient Defense against Knowledge Corruption Attacks on RAG Systems
authors: Minseok Kim and Hankook Lee and Hyungjoon Koo

metrics_reported_or_relevant: ASR, accuracy, latency, cost
actual_contribution: Post-retrieval lightweight filtering (TF-IDF clustering + concentration-based grouping) against knowledge corruption/poisoning attacks on RAG.

metrics_reported_or_relevant: Accuracy, LLM-judge score, ASR (appendix), benign vs attack at positions

title: RAGPart \& RAGMask: Retrieval-Stage Defenses Against Corpus Poisoning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Pankayaraj Pathmanathan and Michael-Andrei Panaitescu-Liess and Cho-Yu Jason Chiang and Furong Huang
benchmark_or_task: Retrievers: Contriever, ANCE, Multilingual E5, GTE-Large; NQ and FiQA datasets
metrics_reported_or_relevant: ASR drop, SR/utility drop, perplexity

title: PoisonArena: Uncovering Competing Poisoning Attacks in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

metrics_reported_or_relevant: Attack Success Rate (ASR) vs. GCG, Corpus Poisoning, Disinformation, Prompt Poisoning, GGPP, PoisonedRAG

authors: Yuxin Zhang and Yan Wang and Yongrui Chen and Shenyu Zhang and Xinbang Dai and Sheng Bi and Guilin Qi

title: MIRAGE: Misleading Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Black-box and Query-agnostic Poisoning Attacks

authors: Viktor Moskvoretskii and Maria Lysyuk and Mikhail Salnikov and Nikolay Ivanov and Sergey Pletenev and Daria Galimzianova and Nikita Krayko and Vasily Konovalov and Irina Nikishina and Alexander Panchenko
